notes.title: The "BETA" is now LIVE!
notes.content:
The "BETA" is now LIVE!


We have decided to make it an "OPEN BETA" for all Steam owners of 10YA
to be able to participate in the beta you will need to opt-in through steam, To do this please follow these instructions.

right-click on the game from the library page and select "Properties". 

Among the available tabs will be the "BETAS" tab.

The beta should be listed in the dropdown menu under "Select the beta you would like to opt into:"

You may need to re-start steam to be able to view the tab.
 

 

Please take the time to read the information below, we'd like help with checking that 10YA runs successfully. We'd particularly like to know: 

•if any functions fail to operate 

•if there are any performance issues remaining.  



Notes: 

1. Rock Paper Games may withdraw this beta software at any time and will withdraw it at the end of the testing period. 


The following improvements are contained in this version of Chapter 1: 


Optimisation of particle effects 

Improvements in use of multicore machines 

Casting lights are scaled back on lower settings 

Improved anti-aliasing 

New Player Model 

New Island level (Unfinshed)

New "BASIC" AI 

Crafting 

Multiplayer 

Upgraded graphics 

New animations 

Updated inventory/crafting interface 

Updated day/night cycle 

New female character 

Base building added (BETA TEST) 

New save/load system 

3 different characters to pick from 

Infected "should" only appear at night/dusk

PLEASE NOTE :

The beta has been set up in such away that you can easily gather resources and there should be plenty lying around for you to test out the crafting and building systems.

Chapter 1 "BETA" is just a test of crafting,inventory,building and multiplayer you can play singleplayer as it is just the same but not online. 

There are NO "QUESTS/STORY" or friendly NPC'S in this build.

The map/models and animations are not all complete, this is more noticed on multiplayer where weapons etc will appear out of scale in the 3rd person view.

You will also notice invisible blockers at the edges of the map.

Also we are aware of a bug if you are running "Avast" where the game will fail to load and steam will "hang" please disable "Avast" before running the beta.
 

Please report bugs using the rockpapergamesdev@gmail.com email address.



Many Thanks 

RPG Team

notes.title: [Official Notice] About Company Change
notes.content:
Dear Players, 

Hello. Today we have a notice about the company change. 
Actually, We already have mentioned about this through 
previous announcement's, but decide to make a official notice to make situation more clear. 

This game, '10 Years After' was developed and serviced by 'TenTreeGames' so far. 

However, the IP(all rights) of this game recently(actually a few months ago) was taken over by RPG(actually us.) 


And now, we are setting in the development team, and looking into game resources which we received and so on. 

The websites and Facebook,Twitter,Youtube accounts for "TenTreeGames" have all gone offline while we move them over to RPG.

The Steam Dev Account has been passed over to us at RPG and the previous owner "AlwaysDead" now has no rights to the "10 Years After" steam page.

There seems to of been a lot of negativity regarding RPG taking over, this has all stemmed from us being to eager to make the announcement and using the old websites/facebook/steam account to inform you.


It has taken time for us to get things transferred over properly but things are now in motion.

Actually, it is taking more time than we originally expected. 


During our  preparing period (it can take a few months from now.), 
we think that you, the  players, may get angry and bored because of some existing problems and no updates. 

We feel very sorry about this, and are trying to make the whole switch over as smooth as possible. 


That's all at today. We will try to communicate with you, as often as we can
through this announcement. 

But due to all the things that need to be sorted this page is not manned 24/7 at the moment once "Chapter 1" releases we will be able to maintain the steam forum at a better rate.

Have a good day. Thank you. 

Best regards, 

RPG

notes.title: Development Roadmap and new Info
notes.content:
[h1]10 Years After Development Road Map [/h1] 


[b] Phase 1: 	[/b] 

  

Go back to basics,  

  

Rework player model to include new : 

  

Animations 

  

Weapons 

  

Hands/Arms 

  

  

  


[b]Phase 2: 	[/b] 

  

Revamp Inventory 

  

Revamp Hunger/Thirst 

  

Revamp Crafting 

  

Add base building 

  

Revamp Save system 



[b]Phase 3: 	[/b] 

  

New AI System 

  

New Map 

  

Update Graphics 



[b]Phase 4:  	[/b] 

  

Revamp Quest system 

  

Revamp Story Mode 

  

  

  


[h1]Update Procedure  [/h1] 



10 Years After will now be updated in Modules, once each module is perfected the development team will move onto the next. 

  

10 Years After will also now launch in "Chapters"  each Chapter will be a free update to owners of the game there will only be one charge for users and that is the initial payment made through Steam. 






[h1]MODULES  [/h1] 



[b]Chapter 1: 	[/b] 

  

After escaping the infection in a plane , You crash land on a small island and need to learn to live from the land and construct shelters until you can be rescued by a passing ship. 

  

  

Dev Notes: 

  

This first chapter gives us chance to test the survival and building systems along with hunger/thirst systems and basic animal AI 


[b]Chapter 2: 	[/b] 

  

Your saved! ....Or are you! the government ship that saved you from your little island holiday has taken you to a survivor camp to be processed. 

  

Dev Notes: 

  

The second chapter introduces the quest and dialogue system to the game, as well as more advanced AI and combat systems 


[h1]Chapter 3/4/5 will be announced soon [/h1] 


Regards

RPG

notes.title: Rock Paper Games Acquires "10 Years After" from Ten Tree Games
notes.content:
As you will of noticed 10 Years After has halted production.


The move comes after several months of coordinated planning by the companies to ensure Ten Tree Games and "10 Years After" will be taken over by Rock Paper Games effective from 5/11/15.

We are still getting things sorted like email/website/social accounts/and steam as well as the "10 Years After" game files, this will take some time to address and sort through until development continues on "10 Years After"

Rock Paper Games are dedicated to bringing "10 Years After" back to life and we have a comprehensive roadmap of new features that will significantly benefit "10 Years After"  users during the upcoming months and beyond.

www.10yearsaftergame.com

notes.title: IMPORTANT PLEASE READ
notes.content:
Ok i feel the need to write this announcement  due to the mixed reviews we are getting on 10YA so here goes...

1st this game is being developed by 1 guy (me) i deal with everything from the social aspects like steam/Facebook/twitter and the website as well as emails etc

2nd there seems to be some problem with people quitting out of the game there are 2 menu's ESC for quest log/save/load and "P" for graphics/quit etc

3rd the whole idea of 10YA seems to be getting lost somewhere , the idea is you are NOT buying a completed game but what you are buying is the ability to be able to help support the game and the development not just by bug reports but with game suggestions/quest ideas anything you think would be good to have in the game 10YA is about building a game together.

4th As most of you are aware i am very open about the state of 10YA and if i can help in anyway you only need to ask.

Due to all these facts i have decided to scale down 10YA slightly to focus on certain things at a time, with this in mind i am going to remove the hunger/thirst system for now and focus on the games layout and quests.

Once we have this nailed down we will then add back into the game crafting and the hunger/thirst and then expand from there.

This also means i can focus on one thing at a time and not be flipping from one problem to another and we can keep the updates coming weekly/fortnightly.

I would also like you guys and girls to comment below about the price of 10YA

As i thought it was about right for the state of the game, what do you think as a community would be a good price?

Just keep in mind the game needs to make some money to help the development.


Many Thanks


Stay Safe Afters

notes.title: The direction of 10YA- The players view
notes.content:
As some of you may have read on this forum I am indeed open to suggestions regarding the development of 10 Years After and now that things are starting to fall into place I wondered the direction the players wanted the game to go in. 

I want all players to feel as though they can help me make this a game they can enjoy, whether with small ideas and input to large ideas. I have the basic setting but can enhance upon whichever features and themes the fans enjoy.

Some ideas have surfaced that although not implemented yet are solid ideas, I've heard menton of pets, then followers, a ledge-grab mechanic to climb and even mention of a Lovecraftian themed doomsday cult (Tasteful of course) and possibly the odd abomination. The limitations lie in the engine but I assure you by release I will make the most of Unity.

So I wonder, we have many interesting well known 'tropes' in the survival genre, ranging from the standard zombie affair to radioactive mutants, blowouts and anomalies to teleporting hell demons, cannibals, cults, aliens, eldritch abominations and cosmic gods the list goes on so where would you like us to fit in all of this? We have many ideas but from day one I've always wanted to make a fan focussed game so, give me your best ideas and lets see what we can come up with :)

I hope you're enjoying the new patch and those of you that aren't please, tell me why I will take on board your critisisms and compliments alike. I hope to hear from you guys soon!

Stay safe out there afters.

“Keep a little fire burning; however small, however hidden.” 

Cormac McCarthy, The Road

notes.title: Update On Alpha 0.0.7
notes.content:
Well as you are aware we are working mostly on the outside areas including the city and the town things are going well a few problems have come about but we are mostly on course for the update coming out this weekend coming!...

What i can confirm is that 10YA is being completely re-worked from the start of the game to the outside area and during some initial tests we are getting a solid 60FPS in the new outside area!

Also as a way to achieve the fps and up the graphics a notch we have separated the towns from the woodlands.

So now you will find and follow a few roads (where you will find infected who have made there way out of the town/city)  until you get asked if you would like to enter the city/town.

You are still free to wander about and come and go as you please between the town/city and the woodlands areas.

During testing this way and dynamic loading it as you walk around we found this way we were able to really up the graphics and keep a nice steady fps rate.

This has also let us drastically increase the size of the city and the town and let us add more grasses and better trees and textures on the woodlands area.

You will also now still start in the flats but you will escape to an outside area where you will have to make your way through the streets and enter the hospital ...the rest we shall keep secret :-)

As i have already said we hope to have this out for 14th/15th of this month as long as things go well,

Depending on the feedback of 0.0.7 we shall then start addressing some of the smaller things for a 0.0.7a patch and then hopefully we can start adding in some cool stuff for 0.0.8


Stay Safe Afters

notes.title: A Message From TenTreeGames
notes.content:
Hi Guys and Girls first off we would like to say thank you to everyone who has brought 10YA and for all the feedback good and bad. 

The reason for this message is to try and help you and potential new players understand the vision for 10YA where we would like to be and where we are now.

First off :  There seems to be some confusion as to what type of game 10YA is and wants to become .....We see 10YA as more of a "Fallout" type game than a "Dayz/Rust" type game although we do wish too add in some features that are similar to what these games already have to offer.


Next where we are now:  Buggy is the best answer more so in the outside area than indoors due to this we are re-making the whole of the outside area which will include re-making all of Oak Hill City/Wenlock Prior etc ....The new 0.0.6a patch that went live today addresses some of the smaller complaints and the confusing main menu!

Once we have the major bugs addressed like FPS etc we will then start adding in more content like quests and weapons food items and user suggestions. 

Talking of user suggestions-

Our aim for 10YA is for you "Afters" to help us build the game by testing and reporting back bugs and any ideas you would like to see in-game or what you would like to see taken out of the game we will go with the majority on any ideas and do our best to put them in-game or remove/fix them.

Also a small bit about TenTreeGames as you know we are a new kid on the block! but we are dedicated to 10YA and our community some of you may be scared we are putting this game out to make a quick buck and never update it ever again, I can assure you this is not the case and i am sure Desura users would agree we update regularly and the only time there was a delay in updating was over the Christmas period .

We hope this helps you to understand what we want 10YA to become where it is now and how important you "Afters" are to us we really do want you to help us make this game become great and you all can have a big say in that.

Stay Safe Afters

Just a quick update to let you know we will be starting work on the first Steam patch on Monday, We will be working through the list on the "Bugs and Stuff" thread in the forum so if you can think of anything please just add it to that thread.

We hope to have this live for Friday it may come in two patches one to fix all the smaller items and another to try and nail down the FPS drops when outside...We may have to remake the outside into smaller parts that load around you as you go if this is the case then this will take a bit longer to push out due to all the work involved  but we will see :-)

Also just wanted to say thanks to everyone who has brought the game on Steam and also its nice to see so many Desura users getting in-touch

Stay Safe Afters

notes.title: Steam keys for Desura owners!
notes.content:
To claim your Steam key (if you own 10YA on Desura), visit this URL: 

http://www.desura.com/collection

And find 10YA on the list. Click keys. Your 10YA Steam key should be there.
To activate it on Steam, open Steam and press 'ADD A GAME...' and then 'Activate A Product On Steam'. 


NOTE: The game will initially display in as 'unreleased' in your Steam library.

If it is not there give it some time to filter through the system

Enjoy!

notes.title: 10YA Features and things to remember
notes.content:
[h1] 10 Years After Things To Expect :[/h1] 

Infected lots and lots of infected

Save/Load system (basic but works) ...When loading game there is no loading screen yet so it will appear like it is not doing anything it is just wait

Huge 5km square main map

3 starting levels to work through until you find your way outside

Guns/Melee weapons

Raiders

Voiced quests and main character 

Basic crafting (this will be expanded in the next update after bug fixes)

Stumble across your own corpse

pick up Apocalyptic Radio Broadcasts as you wander round

Animals

Hunger/Thirst System

Day / Night Cycle

Weather Effects

And lots more but we don't want to give it away ;-)


[h1] Things to take note of:[/h1] 

This is an [u]Early Access Game[/u] so expect bugs in the game be that a floating pig or getting stuck somewhere! this is the main point of early access so you can help us test and find any bugs.

Some models in-game are just place holders and will be update as we move along, also some to almost all of the infected animations are being re-worked so these too are just place holders for now.

New quests are being written as we speak and we hope to have these in-game in the next week or two to help expand the 10YA world.

Stay Safe Afters
